# Compression

## Vertical
- `Session IO and emulation: io, io_thread, io_thr`: combines owned emulator state, a writer-thread controller, worker handles and backend execution state. POSIX output additionally uses separate gather and parser threads with a bounded buffer pipeline; Windows retains a serial reader. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`, `src/termio/Thread.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`.
- `terminal_stream: StreamHandler.Stream`: hides the parser/handler boundary and stateful APC, DCS and clipboard transactions, including session clipboard grants and optional tmux viewer state. Sources: `src/terminal/stream.zig`, `src/termio/stream_handler.zig`.
- `terminal: terminal.Terminal -- authoritative emulator state`: compresses terminal-wide state, lazily initialized screens, page-backed storage and reference validity. Cursor, selection, charset and Kitty keyboard/image state belong to `Screen`, not to `PageList`. Sources: `src/terminal/Terminal.zig`, `src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig`, `src/terminal/Screen.zig`, `src/terminal/PageList.zig`, `src/terminal/page.zig`.
- `Presentation: renderer, renderer_state, renderer_thread, renderer_thr`: merges three distinct structures: shared-access state, per-surface rendering resources and scheduling machinery. The renderer also owns a drawing mutex, snapshot storage, shaping caches, swap-chain resources and an optional display link. Sources: `src/renderer/State.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`.
- `Search: optional Surface.Search`: hides per-screen searchers, an independent viewport search, active/history search state, screen generations and tracked selected matches. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/terminal/search/Thread.zig`, `src/terminal/search/terminal.zig`, `src/terminal/search/screen.zig`.
- `Inspector: optional owned Inspector`: hides the distinction between the core-owned recording/model state and runtime-specific inspector presentation. Sources: `src/inspector/Inspector.zig`, `src/inspector/widgets/surface.zig`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig`.
- `font_grid_key, font_size, font_metrics, font_size_adjusted`: represents a retained reference, not ownership of the font subsystem. The App-owned set contains reference-counted grids, a font library and discovery machinery; each grid owns its resolver, caches and atlases. Sources: `src/App.zig`, `src/font/SharedGridSet.zig`, `src/font/SharedGrid.zig`.

## Horizontal
- `surfaceMailbox(), handleMessage()`: surface messages pass through the App queue, wake the runtime, and are dispatched only after checking that the target surface remains registered. Sources: `src/apprt/surface.zig`, `src/App.zig`.
- `Lifecycle implementation: init(), deinit(), needsConfirmQuit(), close()`: close requests and destruction are separate. Shutdown ordering also protects display-link callbacks, selection pins and search references into terminal storage. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig`.
- `User interaction and terminal actions (src/Surface.zig)`: input branches into host actions, local terminal mutations, preedit updates and mode-dependent byte encoding. Clipboard requests have asynchronous authorization/completion paths, not merely a paste call. Source: `src/Surface.zig`.
- `queueIo() -- common outgoing-message gate`: ownership transfer and queue backpressure matter. Read-only filtering applies to writes passing through this Surface gate; terminal-generated replies can enter the IO mailbox directly. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/mailbox.zig`, `src/termio/stream_handler.zig`.
- `Configuration, font selection and geometry (src/Surface.zig)`: configuration replacement invalidates binding pointers; font replacement transfers retirement of the old grid to the renderer thread; resize fans out asynchronously and is also forwarded by Termio after resizing the PTY and emulator. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`.
- `renderer_state: renderer.State`: the mutex connects parsing, input, snapshots, search and inspection. Demand/handoff atomics prevent sustained POSIX parsing from starving snapshots. Sources: `src/renderer/State.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`.
- `renderer_thread: renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle`: wakeup, frame update and drawing are not one unconditional chain. Visibility, display realization, synchronized output and vsync affect different stages; compression scheduling reaches back into terminal storage. Sources: `src/renderer/Thread.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`.
- `searchCallback_() -> renderer mailbox with viewport/selected-match highlights`: results split into copied rendering highlights and main-thread UI notifications; their underlying screen/page identities can become stale. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/terminal/search/terminal.zig`, `src/renderer/generic.zig`.

## Session · current

Keep the supplied diagram as the navigation overview. Add adjacent views for Surface-level coordination rather than repeating the internals delegated below.

Throughout the plan, diagrams are views, not additional runtime objects. Repeated endpoint names retain one identity. T means composition; borrowed pointers, calls, notifications and data flow use E.

### Diagrams

- **lifecycle · Construction, close and destruction**: horizontal; anchored to Session/core → `Lifecycle implementation: init(), deinit(), needsConfirmQuit(), close()`. Trace construction before worker startup, host-mediated close, search → renderer → IO stop/join ordering, and subsequent resource release. Show renderer destruction before renderer-thread state destruction because the display link references `draw_now`. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/termio/Exec.zig`.
- **interaction · Input decisions and clipboard round trips**: horizontal; anchored to Session/core → `User interaction and terminal actions (src/Surface.zig)`. Trace key sequences and key tables, binding actions versus encoding, mouse reporting versus local selection/scrolling, text/paste versus preedit, and clipboard completion/denial. End byte-producing branches at `queueIo`; do not redraw backend internals. Source: `src/Surface.zig`.
- **reconfigure · Configuration, font and size propagation**: horizontal; anchored to Session/core → `Configuration, font selection and geometry (src/Surface.zig)`. Show copied derived configuration, binding-state reset, preserved manually adjusted font size, new-grid acquisition, renderer-side old-grid retirement, geometry calculation and asynchronous resize/configuration fan-out. Sources: `src/Surface.zig`, `src/renderer/Thread.zig`, `src/termio/Termio.zig`.
- **inspection · Optional inspector model**: vertical; anchored to Session/core → `Inspector: optional owned Inspector`. Decompose mouse inspection and GUI model into surface/terminal/renderer information, keyboard history and VT recording. # Summary

The plan uses six canvases: one coordination canvas, four child canvases and one same-level host/shared-resource canvas. Vertical expansion concentrates on actual ownership and storage; horizontal expansion exposes threading, asynchronous delivery, locking and lifetime transitions.

Verified at `ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af`, with the checkout unchanged.

Important corrections and qualifications:

- POSIX PTY reading is a **gather/parser pipeline**, not one reader loop.
- Cursor, selection and Kitty state belong to **Screen**, not PageList.
- `queueIo()` is a **Surface write gate**, not a global prohibition on protocol replies.
- Font replacement retires the old reference **on the renderer thread after installation**.
- Wakeup → update → draw is conditional; host-driven drawing does **not** imply a fresh snapshot.
- Terminal, renderer snapshot and shared font grid remain distinct identities with different owners.
